pipeline.description: Classifies the issue as bug, feature, chore, or spike. Validates required fields (problem statement, acceptance criteria). Rejects malformed issues with a corrective comment.

Drafts a Product Requirements Document for an appropriately-sized issue. Posts it as an issue comment in user-story + Gherkin format and waits for stakeholder approval at the prd:approved gate. Folds in product-standards-checker (per roadmap MVP merges): inline-flags any product-layer standards violations in the same PRD comment. Set-blocks oversized issues with a decomposition note rather than drafting a sprawling PRD.
